## Supporting Evidence
The `opencode-gemini-auth` plugin works correctly with `/connect` because its provider ID 
is `"google"`, which IS registered in models.dev. 
After `/instance/dispose`, the Gemini provider continues to work because 
`database["google"]` exists in models.dev, so `mergeProvider()` succeeds.
In contrast, custom providers like `"qwen-code"` are NOT in models.dev, so 
`mergeProvider()` fails silently after instance disposal.
This confirms the root cause: providers must exist in models.dev OR be added to 
the database before mergeProvider() is called.

Opened #20187 as a fix. The root cause is that `ctx.metadata()` fires while the part is still pending, and the processor's tool-call handler overwrites it with a fresh state. Fix uses a synchronous side-channel on the processor context to buffer metadata until the tool-call handler can merge it.

@rekram1-node 

For opencode TUI, the core bug is this:

  1. Auto-compaction creates a synthetic role: "user" continuation turn in projects/opencode/packages/opencode/src/
     session/compaction.ts:307.
  2. Copilot header logic in projects/opencode/packages/opencode/src/plugin/copilot.ts:302 only special-cases:
      - compaction-part messages
      - subagent sessions
        so this continuation falls through.
  3. Auth fallback in projects/opencode/packages/opencode/src/plugin/copilot.ts:70 classifies last user message as x-
     initiator: user, so premium gets burned.

  That matches the maintainer’s March 20 note: “Only /compact is billing free rn” (auto-compaction not)
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/8030#issuecomment-4095020985

  Fix (TUI, aligned with Copilot CLI usage):

  - In chat.headers, set x-initiator: agent for system-generated user turns, not just compaction/subagent.
  - Best robust approach: add explicit initiator metadata on user messages (initiator: "user" | "agent"), set "agent"
    for synthetic/internal turns (auto-compaction continue/replay, task-command synthetic prompt, plan/shell-
    generated turns), and drive header from that.
  - At minimum quick patch: detect synthetic-only user messages and mark agent; also mark compaction replay copies as
    synthetic so replay is not billed as user.

  This aligns with Copilot CLI’s “only submitted prompt consumes premium request” model:
  README: https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/blob/main/README.md#L137
  Also consistent with the continuation/subagent distinction discussed in issue #8030:
  https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/8030#issuecomment-3781527023
